batch.scope: Boundary-case pilot across selected ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42 catalogue records, published standards, a DIS, an amendment CD, a withdrawn edition, and an ISO event-news negative control; not an exhaustive ISO/IEC collection.

records.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Management system
appliesTo: organizations developing, providing, or using AI systems
AI management systems and voluntary certification
records.reason: Official published International Standard with a unique reference, current edition, direct AI scope, cross-sector organizational applicability, and no duplicate library object.
limitations: Voluntary unless separately incorporated into law, contract, or procurement rules
ISO does not itself certify organizations
Full normative text is copyrighted and generally paid

records.title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology
records.reason: Official current terminology standard; the in-development Amendment 2 is separately identified and merged as version-related material.
limitations: Public catalogue metadata does not reproduce the complete normative definitions
An in-development amendment is not yet part of the current text

records.title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022/CD Amd 2
records.reason: Official Committee Draft amendment at stage 30.20; retain in the parent standard's version history rather than representing it as a published amendment.
limitations: Under development
Content and status may change
Not part of the current published edition

records.title: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Guidance on risk management
appliesTo: organizations developing, producing, deploying, or using AI products, systems, and services
records.reason: Official current AI risk-management guidance with a distinct purpose and clearly stated organizational scope.
limitations: Guidance rather than a generally binding law
Implementation is tailored to organizational context

records.title: ISO/IEC 42005:2025 Information technology — Artificial intelligence (AI) — AI system impact assessment
appliesTo: organizations conducting AI system impact assessments
impacts on individuals, groups, and society
records.reason: Official published AI impact-assessment standard with a use distinct from management-system and risk-management standards.
limitations: Does not automatically satisfy jurisdiction-specific legal impact-assessment duties
Application remains system- and context-specific

records.title: ISO/IEC 42006:2025 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Requirements for bodies providing audit and certification of artificial intelligence management systems
appliesTo: certification bodies auditing ISO/IEC 42001 management systems
records.reason: Official current requirements standard for AIMS certification bodies, distinct from requirements placed on organizations implementing ISO/IEC 42001.
limitations: Primarily applies to certification and accreditation bodies
Supplements rather than replaces ISO/IEC 17021-1

records.title: ISO/IEC TR 24030:2024 Information technology — Artificial intelligence (AI) — Use cases
records.reason: Official current revision of the AI use-case technical report; a new revision is under development but has not yet replaced it.
limitations: Informative Technical Report
A further revision is under development
Use cases are representative rather than statistically exhaustive

records.title: ISO/IEC TR 24030:2021 Information technology — Artificial intelligence (AI) — Use cases
appliesTo: historical edition of the ISO/IEC AI use-case report
records.reason: Officially withdrawn first edition revised by the 2024 edition; retain only as version history.
limitations: Withdrawn
Revised by ISO/IEC TR 24030:2024

records.title: ISO/IEC DIS 42007 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — High-level framework and guidance for the development of conformity assessment schemes for AI systems
appliesTo: regulators, purchasing bodies, and industry organizations
records.reason: Official Draft International Standard at enquiry stage 40.20 with an independent conformity-assessment use; eligible only with prominent draft status.
limitations: Not a published International Standard
Ballot outcome and technical content may change

records.title: World-first International AI Standards Summit to be held in 2025
records.reason: Official ISO event announcement, but not a standard, formal draft, guidance document, regulatory instrument, or conformity-assessment decision.
limitations: May be used only as discovery or event context
